WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
legislator_info AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.state
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
term_years AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.first_name, lt.last_name,
           date_part('year', CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as start_year,
           date_part('year', CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)) as end_year,
           ft.first_term_start,
           date_part('year', CAST(ft.first_term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_year
    FROM legislator_info lt
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
),
year_range AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, first_term_year, start_year, end_year, first_name, last_name,
           UNNEST(generate_series(start_year, end_year - 1, 1)) as year_in_term
    FROM term_years
    WHERE start_year <= end_year - 1
),
years_elapsed_calc AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, first_term_year, year_in_term, first_name, last_name,
           year_in_term - first_term_year as years_elapsed
    FROM year_range
)
SELECT id_bioguide, first_name, last_name, first_term_start, first_term_year, year_in_term, years_elapsed
FROM years_elapsed_calc
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
ORDER BY id_bioguide, years_el

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT 1842 as year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1 FROM years WHERE year < 2068
),
first_term AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
legislator_first_term AS (
    SELECT mll.id_bioguide, ft.first_term_start
    FROM male_la_legislators mll
    JOIN first_term ft ON mll.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    WHERE ft.first_term_start IS NOT NULL
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        y.year,
        y.year - CAST(SUBSTR(lft.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as years_elapsed
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    CROSS JOIN years y
    WHERE y.year - CAST(SUBSTR(lft.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 31 AND 49
),
actively_serving AS (
    SELECT 
        ytc.id_bioguide,
        ytc.year,
        ytc.years_elapsed,
        CASE WHEN lt.term_start <= CAST(date(ytc.year || '-12-31') AS TEXT) AND CAST(date(ytc.year || '-12-31') AS TEXT) <= lt.term_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_serving
    FROM years_to_check ytc
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ytc.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide AND lt.state = 'LA'
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM actively_serving
WHERE is_serving = 1
GROUP BY y
